Ruijie RG-RAP6262(G) Outdoor Wi-Fi 6 Access Point – IP67 Waterproof | 1775Mbps High-Speed for Harsh Environments

The Ruijie RG-RAP6262(G) is a high-performance dual-band outdoor Wi-Fi 6 access point offering ultra-fast wireless connectivity up to 1775Mbps, engineered for extreme environments. Its IP67-rated enclosure protects against water, dust, and heat, making it perfect for ISPs, public parks, educational campuses, and industrial zones in Bangladesh.

Built with the latest 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) technology, it delivers enhanced speed, reduced latency, and better multi-device performance using OFDMA and MU-MIMO. It supports dual-stream 2x2 MIMO on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands and includes Gigabit Ethernet uplinks with PoE+ support for simplified deployment.

Key Features

  • Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax (Wi-Fi 6)
  • Max Throughput: Up to 1775Mbps 
  • Antennas: Built-in Omnidirectional Antennas
  • Protection Rating: IP67 Waterproof & Dustproof
  • Ports: 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet ports (1 PoE+ in)
  • Power: PoE+ (802.3at) compliant
  • Centralized management via Ruijie Cloud or Ruijie App
  • Security: WPA3, 802.1x authentication, ACL, rogue AP detection
  • Ideal coverage: Outdoor up to 300 meters (open space)
